body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Haier unveiled its new WiFi-enabled PMP during CES 2007, which features 2.5-inch screen 30GB HDD, WiFi connectivity, Bluetooth. It will be loaded with ‘Smart-Screens’ software, which is launched by AOL; it is optimized application that enables users to take advantages of various multimedia contents directly on their portable multimedia players in wireless environment without the need for pc.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
